question: dev-services/stytch: Stytch states that Twilio completed its acquisition of Stytch on 2025-11-14 (changelog.stytch.com/announcements/2025-11-14-a-new-chapter-begins-stytch-joins-twilio), and the sign-up page now links Twilio's privacy notice. Should the entity of dev-services/stytch be grouped with the Twilio entity of registry/entities.tsv, which holds email/sendgrid?
why: The store keeps Stytch as its own entity (stytch.com), so a vendor-level query for Twilio does not return it. An entity override is outside the operations of a verify lane.
